// diagnostic

E0209

A named binding passed where it would be silently cloned — Move-param arg without the move marker `^`, or a std constructor consuming a borrowed value (D-MEM1/S2; hard error, was lint `L0201`)

What

A named binding passed where it would be silently cloned — Move-param arg without the move marker `^`, or a std constructor consuming a borrowed value (D-MEM1/S2; hard error, was lint `L0201`)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Add `^` to the move argument or use a non-consuming constructor.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0209: tests/ui/card_2387_core_field_policy_probe.stderr.

Error [E0209]: Implicit clone of `value`
  --> tests/ui/card_2387_core_field_policy_probe.jet:4:23
    |
  4 |     node :: JSON.Text(value)
    |                       ^^^^^
 Why: `Text` stores its own copy of this value
 Fix: Write `~value` to copy explicitly
